title: HF4743 (2025-2026 Regular): Sale and possession of toxic ammunition prohibited.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2026-03-26; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/HF/4743/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version, 2026-03-26. Civil penalties: $500 first offense, $1,000 to $5,000 for later ones (subd. 2). Also adds hunting-education and range-grant conditions (sections 2-3) and a buyback and exchange program if funded. The environmental purpose (lead toxicity) is treated as part of the ammunition rule, not a separate subject.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 87A.02, subd. 2): (b) The shooting range performance standards under this chapter include a prohibition on possessing and using lead ammunition.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 325F.016): (a) Beginning August 1, 2027, no manufacturer or wholesaler may sell or offer for sale lead ammunition in this state.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 325F.016): (b) Beginning August 1, 2028, no retailer may sell or offer for sale lead ammunition in this state.
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.7193, subd. 1): Beginning August 1, 2028, a person must not use or possess lead ammunition.
